mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth decelerates by more than 2pp YoY, it signals a supply crunch that will hurt corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth decelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) growth accelerates by more than 10% YoY, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST YoY growth > 10% but SPX 60-day returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will slow consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth decelerates by more than 5% YoY, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will hurt corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS YoY growth decelerates by > 5% but SPX 60-day returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
